title: Dark Sorcerer Ritual
description: A hooded sorcerer with a skull-like mask and multiple floating spell circles sits atop a mound of earth, gesturing with both hands. In a dark, starry landscape, smaller hooded figures study books on the ground while an ominous mountain with a glowing crown looms in the background.
prompt: A powerful hooded sorcerer wearing a skull mask and white robes sits cross-legged on a mound of dark earth, hands raised in spellcasting, surrounded by numerous glowing golden magical circles and runes floating in the air. Smaller hooded acolytes kneel on the ground reading ancient books, set against a dark fantasy landscape with a towering ominous mountain crowned by fire under a starry night sky, in a detailed monochrome ink and gold accent style.
